purpose: Deterministic session calendar for the F-01 Session-Partition Reference Process V38A registration
dst_rule: Session boundaries are wall-clock in America/New_York. Feed bar timestamps are translated to America/New_York via UTC before boundary comparison, per the registered normalization rule (dynamic UTC translation handles DST shifts).
weekend: Saturday and Sunday are non-trading days; no session, no decision, no population entry.
source: Official NYSE/Nasdaq published trading calendar (public record), encoded for 2026-2027. Stage-2 calendar-integrity check reconciles this artifact against the official published schedule; any outcome-independent discrepancy is corrected, re-hashed, and recorded as a mechanical completion before Stage-2 execution.
study_horizon: Validation-eligible sessions begin at the registration freeze (2026-09-03) and extend through the confirmation segment (approximately 2027-02-26). The full 2026-2027 calendar is encoded for infrastructure completeness; dates outside the horizon do not affect the study.

early_closes_2027.name: Last full trading day before Christmas holiday (NYSE half-day convention)
early_closes_2027.reconciliation_flag: Confirm against official published 2027 schedule at Stage 2

extraordinary_closure_policy: Unexpected closures (exchange-declared market closures not listed above) are recorded by the Stage-2 pipeline as no-session days with a documented reason; they do not create decisions or population entries. No discretionary closures are recognized.
notes: Early-close sessions use 13:00 ET as the session-close boundary for the F-01 rule.
The calendar is infrastructure, not a tuning variable; no calendar version was selected to favor any observation set.
The 2026-07-11 through 2026-09-02 window is outside both the sealed baseline archive and the study horizon; it exists only in protected forward artifacts and is excluded entirely.
